text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond took 1st place in
brilliant 
fashion. However, she asked to compete 
next at a long distance, which was Mejiro 
McQueen's forte.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, Mejiro McQueen proposed that the 
four of them, including Tokai Teio,
run in 
the Arima Kinen together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Satono Diamond asked 
Mejiro McQueen about how she carries 
herself as a "renowned Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen answered that it meant 
overcoming the strong and continuing to 
uphold the Mejiro family's prestige.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing that,
Satono Diamond began to 
reflect deeply on what it truly meant to 
be a "celebrated Umamusume."
